# Controller failover and 100-agent Lit source pilot

The `pinned-pi-091c058f` pilot ran on 2026-11-20 (Pacific time) from the
sandbox Git pin `57910ab4cf28b8807a627f8ffdd23dc75a0bc3c8`. Pi ran on host-a (34 workers),
host-e (33 workers), and host-f (33 workers), with all inference on host-a.
The agents inserted 100 test-only Rust functions at 96 approved anchors
in eight shared Lit modules. Their file access was confined and the
trusted checker accepted only the approved Rust test insertion.

The modules were `src/config.rs`, `src/core/diff.rs`, `src/core/merge.rs`, `src/core/objects.rs`, `src/core/refs.rs`, `src/errors.rs`, `src/response.rs`, `src/storage/index.rs`. All 100 intended tests passed on the
preflight tree. The exact audited final tree passed the same 100 native
Rust tests on macOS and Linux x86-64.

## Controller and policy observer recovery

The controller replicated a checkpoint to host-a after it observed a
live merge queue entry. The original Mac controller exited after the
broker accepted a reassignment. The Linux controller used the previously
replicated checkpoint and adopted that same claim after one assignment
submission. The Mac's temporary scheduler certificate received HTTP 403.
The Linux controller used its own scoped TLS certificate, SSH key and
existing GitHub login. The Mac policy observer was unloaded until the
Linux controller finished. Broker health and the independent Linux
observer were verified after the original policy observation expired.
The physical Mac remained online for verification.

The Linux controller also exited after removing one temporary worker
directory. Restart detected the earlier removal, finished cleanup, and
preserved the verified receipts. Both temporary scheduler certificates
were revoked, the pilot SSH key was removed, and the Mac observer was
restored after the drill.

## Protected integration

Four 25-assignment publication windows released their terminal branch
freezes before the next window. The audit matched 100 exact Git merges
to successful native Actions runs, retained 112 successful PR checks,
and found no manual statuses or bypass actors. Twelve older attempts
retired and were denied both publication and registration.

The final sandbox main was `8e87977e5a4a23d56a5fcb99ffd5d507632ea33e`. All four conflict repairs
preserved the peer's already-merged test. The broker remained healthy,
the native queue emptied, all 100 temporary worker identities were
denied, and the original rulesets and both broker configs were restored.

The observed inference queue peaked at 92 waiting
requests, with up to 8 running in the samples.
19 initial coding assignments needed at least one
retry. The retry reasons and transcript hashes are in the structured
evidence. All 163 broker and pilot regression tests passed on macOS,
host-a, host-e, and host-f. This pilot used recovery commit `ba61832`
and kept post-MIT upstream black-box.
